description: This Python script sets up an AI-powered voice assistant that handles weather and restaurant recommendations via external APIs, integrates with various transports, maintains session configurations, and registers functions for real-time invocation within a pipeline framework.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema class for defining function interfaces with name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema class for aggregating and managing tools/functions in the system.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Audio VAD (Voice Activity Detection) analyzer implementation used for speech detection.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame in the language model pipeline execution.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Pipeline class managing a sequence of processing steps for AI workflows.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Executor class responsible for running pipeline tasks.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration class for pipeline parameters like metrics and usage tracking.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a discrete task with a pipeline and execution parameters.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Context object for managing and formatting interactions with an OpenAI-compatible language model.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Input arguments and configuration for running the bot instance.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Utility function to instantiate communication transports based on configuration.

classes.name: AzureRealtimeBetaLLMService
classes.description: API client for interacting with Azure Realtime Beta LLM service.

classes.name: InputAudioTranscription
classes.description: Configuration for audio transcription model used for speech-to-text.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Session configuration data for managing conversational context.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function that simulates fetching weather data based on the requested temperature format.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function that provides a static restaurant recommendation.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main function that initializes and runs the AI voice assistant pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: High-level entry point for executing the bot, handling transport creation and starting the pipeline.
